overall_summary: All historical videos have extremely low views (5 to 15) and zero engagement, indicating the channel is in a cold start phase. Confidence is very low, requiring a controlled exploration strategy focused on high-retention narrative hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: All recent videos show near-zero views and zero engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Test distinct emotional topics and sharper hooks to find initial traction.

weak_patterns.evidence: Phrases like 'नंबर ब्लॉक नहीं किया' and 'रात के दो बजे' yielded low numbers (5-10 views).
weak_patterns.action: Shift from broad late-night clichés to hyper-specific, tangible everyday objects and actions.

next_video.concept: Deleting a long-saved chat history not out of anger, but out of self-respect when realization hits that the conversation was entirely one-sided.
next_video.opening_direction: Start by staring at a WhatsApp chat export file or the last message sent three months ago that remains unreplied.
next_video.twist_direction: Realizing that pressing 'delete chat' finally brings peace instead of the fear of losing them forever.
next_video.reason: Evening hours align naturally with reflection on self-worth and solitude.

experiment: Testing whether hyper-specific digital cleanup actions ('chat export/delete') drive better retention than generic phone/number relationship tropes.
